component.name: ReplayNES
component.summary: Record, rewind and replay NES play

description.p: ReplayNES records NES play frame by frame: rewind, fast-forward, slow motion and frame stepping never change what was recorded. Built on the Nestopia UE core with display-locked, low-latency pacing.
On the Steam Deck, "Add to Steam" puts ReplayNES into the Steam library with its own capsule, hero, logo and icon artwork.
Stepping forward while paused no longer starts a new take, the HOME button can no longer be assigned, "Pause after rewind" is off by default, clickable breadcrumbs, and Retry > Restart Recording.
New Quick Menu (L+R) with six categories, redesigned controls (east confirms by default), seek-bar A/B markers for practice, and a game library with a built-in title database.
Shared desktop frontend with the new native Windows app; controller glyph fixes.
Built-in on-screen keyboard for the Steam Deck controller, and Rename (Y) on the Bookmarks and Practice lists.
